impact.en: Increased landslide risk on steep slopes and in previously affected areas
impact.sw: Ongezeko la hatari ya maporomoko ya ardhi kwenye miteremko mikali na maeneo yaliyowahi kuathirika

en: Know the safe area and the route to it.
Prepare an emergency bag.
Keep a reserve of food, drinking water, cash and medicines.
Save the emergency number 190.
sw: Fahamu eneo salama na njia ya kufika huko.
Andaa begi la dharura.
Weka akiba ya chakula, maji ya kunywa, fedha na dawa.
Hifadhi namba ya dharura 190.

impact.en: Saturated soil weakening the foundations of hillside homes
impact.sw: Udongo uliojaa maji kudhoofisha misingi ya nyumba za miteremkoni

en: Inspect walls and foundations for cracks.
Clear gutters and drains around the house.
Direct rainwater away from the house and the slope.
sw: Kagua kuta na misingi kuangalia nyufa.
Safisha mifereji ya paa na mitaro kuzunguka nyumba.
Elekeza maji ya mvua mbali na nyumba na mteremko.

impact.en: New cracks in the ground, roads or walls
impact.sw: Nyufa mpya ardhini, barabarani au kwenye kuta

en: Mark the cracks and check them every day.
Report widening cracks to Village/Mtaa leaders.
Do not build, dig or farm on cracked ground.
sw: Weka alama kwenye nyufa na zikague kila siku.
Toa taarifa ya nyufa zinazoongezeka kwa viongozi wa Kijiji/Mtaa.
Usijenge, usichimbe wala usilime kwenye ardhi yenye nyufa.

impact.en: Doors and windows suddenly sticking in hillside homes
impact.sw: Milango na madirisha kuanza kukwama ghafla katika nyumba za miteremkoni

en: Check walls and foundations for new cracks.
Report to Village/Mtaa leaders.
Sleep elsewhere until the house has been inspected.
sw: Kagua kuta na misingi kuangalia nyufa mpya.
Toa taarifa kwa viongozi wa Kijiji/Mtaa.
Lala mahali pengine hadi nyumba ikaguliwe.

impact.en: Tilting trees, fences and poles on slopes
impact.sw: Miti, uzio na nguzo kuinama kwenye miteremko

en: Keep away from the area below them.
Report them to Village/Mtaa leaders.
Report tilting power poles to TANESCO.
sw: Kaa mbali na eneo lililo chini yake.
Toa taarifa kwa viongozi wa Kijiji/Mtaa.
Toa taarifa ya nguzo za umeme zinazoinama kwa TANESCO.

impact.en: New springs or wet patches appearing on slopes
impact.sw: Chemchemi mpya au unyevu usio wa kawaida kujitokeza kwenye miteremko

en: Report them to Village/Mtaa leaders immediately.
Do not build or dig near them.
sw: Toa taarifa kwa viongozi wa Kijiji/Mtaa mara moja.
Usijenge wala kuchimba karibu nayo.

impact.en: Blocked drainage channels and culverts on hillsides
impact.sw: Mifereji na makalavati kuziba katika maeneo ya milimani

en: Clear drains and culverts before heavy rain.
Do not dump waste in waterways.
Report blocked culverts to TARURA or TANROADS.
sw: Safisha mitaro na makalavati kabla ya mvua kubwa.
Usitupe taka kwenye mifereji ya maji.
Toa taarifa ya makalavati yaliyoziba kwa TARURA au TANROADS.

impact.en: Weakening of terraces and hillside farms
impact.sw: Kudhoofika kwa matuta na mashamba ya miteremkoni

en: Repair terraces and open field drainage.
Stop cultivation on saturated slopes.
Plant trees and grass on bare slopes.
sw: Karabati matuta na fungua mifereji shambani.
Sitisha kilimo kwenye miteremko iliyojaa maji.
Panda miti na nyasi kwenye miteremko iliyo wazi.

impact.en: Isolated rockfalls on mountain roads
impact.sw: Mawe kuanguka katika baadhi ya barabara za milimani

en: Drive slowly on mountain roads.
Do not stop below cliffs or steep road cuttings.
Report fallen rocks to TANROADS or TARURA.
sw: Endesha taratibu kwenye barabara za milimani.
Usisimame chini ya majabali au kingo za barabara zilizochongwa.
Toa taarifa ya mawe yaliyoanguka kwa TANROADS au TARURA.

impact.en: Higher risk for people with special needs and for communities at the foot of mountains
impact.sw: Hatari kubwa zaidi kwa watu wenye mahitaji maalum na jamii zilizo chini ya milima

en: Village/Mtaa and Ward Disaster Management Committees: review landslide contingency plans, update the list of people with special needs and identify safe areas and routes.
Communities at the foot of mountains and along stream channels: know your safe area.
Share this advisory with neighbours, especially older persons, people with disabilities and pregnant women.
sw: Kamati za Usimamizi wa Maafa za Vijiji/Mitaa na Kata: pitieni mipango ya dharura ya maporomoko, boresheni orodha ya watu wenye mahitaji maalum na bainisheni maeneo na njia salama.
Jamii zilizo chini ya milima na kando ya mikondo ya vijito: fahamuni eneo lenu salama.
Wapatie taarifa hii majirani, hasa wazee, watu wenye ulemavu na wajawazito.

impact.en: Warning status
impact.sw: Hali ya tahadhari

en: Please continue to follow updates from TMA, Disaster Management Committees and local leaders.
This advisory remains in place until the authorities update or withdraw it.
sw: Tafadhali endeleeni kufuatilia taarifa za TMA, Kamati za Usimamizi wa Maafa na viongozi wa eneo.
Tahadhari hii itaendelea hadi mamlaka zitakapoihuisha au kuiondoa rasmi.

impact.en: Small landslides and slope failures in vulnerable areas
impact.sw: Maporomoko madogo ya ardhi katika maeneo hatarishi

en: Households on landslide-prone slopes: please move to a safe place early.
Move before nightfall or heavy downpours.
Follow instructions from Village/Mtaa leaders.
District and Ward Committees: open temporary shelters and alert communities by radio, loudspeaker and door-to-door.
sw: Kaya zilizo kwenye miteremko hatarishi: tafadhali hamieni mahali salama mapema.
Hameni kabla ya usiku au mvua kubwa.
Fuateni maelekezo ya viongozi wa Kijiji/Mtaa.
Kamati za Wilaya na Kata: fungueni makazi ya muda na toeni tahadhari kwa jamii kupitia redio, vipaza sauti na nyumba kwa nyumba.

impact.en: Damage to homes and walls from ground movement
impact.sw: Uharibifu wa nyumba na kuta kutokana na kusogea kwa ardhi

en: Leave cracked or damaged buildings.
Do not sleep in houses with new cracks.
Report damage to Village/Mtaa leaders.
sw: Ondoka kwenye majengo yenye nyufa au yaliyoharibika.
Usilale kwenye nyumba zenye nyufa mpya.
Toa taarifa ya uharibifu kwa viongozi wa Kijiji/Mtaa.

impact.en: Mountain roads and small bridges blocked by mud, stones and trees
impact.sw: Barabara za milimani na madaraja madogo kuzibwa na tope, mawe na miti

en: Avoid travel on mountain roads.
Do not cross or clear debris yourself.
Report blockages to TANROADS, TARURA or the Police.
sw: Epuka kusafiri kwenye barabara za milimani.
Usivuke wala kuondoa kifusi mwenyewe.
Toa taarifa ya vizuizi kwa TANROADS, TARURA au Polisi.

impact.en: Risk of injury from falling debris and collapsing slopes
impact.sw: Hatari ya majeraha kutokana na kifusi kinachoanguka na miteremko kuporomoka

en: Stay away from steep slopes, cliffs and quarries.
Stop farming, quarrying and small-scale mining on slopes.
Keep children away from slopes and gullies.
sw: Kaa mbali na miteremko mikali, majabali na machimbo.
Sitisha kilimo, uchimbaji wa kokoto na madini kwenye miteremko.
Waweke watoto mbali na miteremko na makorongo.

impact.en: Streams suddenly turning muddy or stopping flow
impact.sw: Vijito kubadilika ghafla kuwa na tope au kukatika kwa mtiririko

en: If a stream stops flowing during heavy rain, leave the valley immediately.
If a stream turns muddy or carries trees and stones, warn people downstream.
Report to Village/Mtaa leaders immediately.
sw: Kijito kikikatika ghafla wakati wa mvua kubwa, ondoka bondeni mara moja.
Kijito kikibadilika kuwa na tope au kubeba miti na mawe, watahadharishe walio chini.
Toa taarifa kwa viongozi wa Kijiji/Mtaa mara moja.

impact.en: Communities at risk of being cut off
impact.sw: Jamii ziko hatarini kukosa mawasiliano ya barabara

en: Store food, drinking water and medicines for at least three days.
Charge phones and keep a battery-powered radio.
District and Ward Disaster Management Committees: meet, activate landslide contingency plans and pre-position rescue teams, tools and supplies.
sw: Hifadhi chakula, maji ya kunywa na dawa za angalau siku tatu.
Chaji simu na uwe na redio inayotumia betri.
Kamati za Usimamizi wa Maafa za Wilaya na Kata: kutaneni, amilisheni mipango ya dharura ya maporomoko na wekeni tayari timu za uokoaji, vifaa na mahitaji.

impact.en: Damage to power and communication lines
impact.sw: Uharibifu wa nyaya za umeme na mawasiliano

en: Stay away from fallen power lines.
Report fallen lines to TANESCO.
sw: Kaa mbali na nyaya za umeme zilizoanguka.
Toa taarifa ya nyaya zilizoanguka kwa TANESCO.

impact.en: Loss of hillside farms, livestock and crops
impact.sw: Upotevu wa mashamba ya miteremkoni, mifugo na mazao

en: Move livestock and food stores away from slopes.
Harvest mature crops only where it is safe.
Report losses to extension officers.
sw: Hamisha mifugo na akiba ya chakula mbali na miteremko.
Vuna mazao yaliyokomaa pale tu ambapo ni salama.
Toa taarifa ya hasara kwa maafisa ugani.

impact.en: Damage to water sources, springs and pipes
impact.sw: Uharibifu wa vyanzo vya maji, chemchemi na mabomba

en: Boil or treat drinking water.
Report damaged water pipes to the water authority or RUWASA.
sw: Chemsha au tibu maji ya kunywa.
Toa taarifa ya mabomba ya maji yaliyoharibika kwa mamlaka ya maji au RUWASA.

impact.en: Unusual sounds: rumbling, cracking trees or knocking rocks
impact.sw: Sauti zisizo za kawaida: mvumo, miti kupasuka au mawe kugongana

en: Leave immediately; run to the side, away from the path of the slide.
Warn your neighbours.
Call 190 or inform Village/Mtaa leaders.
sw: Ondoka mara moja; kimbia pembeni, mbali na njia ya maporomoko.
Watahadharishe majirani.
Piga 190 au toa taarifa kwa viongozi wa Kijiji/Mtaa.

impact.en: Unsafe routes to school and possible school closures
impact.sw: Njia zisizo salama kwenda shule na uwezekano wa shule kufungwa

en: Parents: keep children off routes along slopes and gullies.
School heads: follow directives from the District Education Office.
sw: Wazazi: msiwaruhusu watoto kupita njia za miteremkoni na makorongoni.
Wakuu wa shule: fuateni maelekezo ya Ofisi ya Elimu ya Wilaya.

impact.en: Warning status
impact.sw: Hali ya tahadhari

en: Please continue to follow updates from TMA, Disaster Management Committees and local leaders.
This warning remains in force until the authorities lower or withdraw it.
sw: Tafadhali endeleeni kufuatilia taarifa za TMA, Kamati za Usimamizi wa Maafa na viongozi wa eneo.
Tahadhari hii itaendelea kutumika hadi mamlaka zitakapoishusha au kuiondoa rasmi.

impact.en: Large landslides and mudflows carrying stones and trees
impact.sw: Maporomoko makubwa ya ardhi na tope linalobeba mawe na miti

en: Residents of slopes, the foot of mountains and stream channels: please evacuate as directed by Village/Mtaa leaders.
Go to stable high ground or an official shelter.
Please do not go back for belongings.
Please return only when the authorities declare the area safe.
sw: Wakazi wa miteremkoni, chini ya milima na kando ya mikondo ya vijito: tafadhali hameni kwa kufuata maelekezo ya viongozi wa Kijiji/Mtaa.
Nenda eneo la mwinuko lililo imara au makazi rasmi ya muda.
Tafadhali usirudi kufuata mali.
Tafadhali rudini pale tu mamlaka zitakapotangaza kuwa eneo ni salama.

impact.en: Homes, vehicles and people buried under mud and debris
impact.sw: Nyumba, magari na watu kufukiwa na tope na kifusi

en: Report missing or buried people immediately: call 190 or inform local leaders.
Do not enter buried areas; wait for rescue teams.
Fire and Rescue Force: lead search and rescue with the Police Force, JWTZ and the Red Cross.
sw: Toa taarifa ya watu waliopotea au kufukiwa mara moja: piga 190 au wajulishe viongozi wa eneo.
Usiingie maeneo yaliyofukiwa; subiri timu za uokoaji.
Jeshi la Zimamoto na Uokoaji: ongozeni utafutaji na uokoaji kwa kushirikiana na Jeshi la Polisi, JWTZ na Chama cha Msalaba Mwekundu.

impact.en: Deaths and injuries
impact.sw: Vifo na majeruhi

en: Take the injured to the nearest health facility.
District Committees: set up first-aid points and provide psychosocial support.
Health authorities: manage identification and burial of the dead.
sw: Wapeleke majeruhi kituo cha afya kilicho karibu.
Kamati za Wilaya: anzisheni vituo vya huduma ya kwanza na toeni msaada wa kisaikolojia.
Mamlaka za afya: simamieni utambuzi na maziko ya waliofariki.

impact.en: Roads and bridges destroyed; communities cut off
impact.sw: Barabara na madaraja kuharibika; jamii kukosa mawasiliano ya barabara

en: Do not travel on mountain roads.
Keep emergency routes clear.
District Committees: open access routes and request air support through the Prime Minister's Office.
sw: Usisafiri kwenye barabara za milimani.
Acha wazi njia za dharura.
Kamati za Wilaya: fungueni njia za kufikia maeneo yaliyoathirika na ombeni usaidizi wa anga kupitia Ofisi ya Waziri Mkuu.

impact.en: Damage to schools, health facilities and public buildings
impact.sw: Uharibifu wa shule, vituo vya afya na majengo ya umma

en: Do not use damaged buildings.
District Committees: set up temporary health and learning points in safe places.
Refer seriously injured people to district or regional hospitals.
sw: Usitumie majengo yaliyoharibika.
Kamati za Wilaya: anzisheni vituo vya muda vya afya na masomo katika maeneo salama.
Wapelekeni majeruhi mahututi hospitali za wilaya au mkoa.

impact.en: Rivers blocked, forming natural dams that may burst
impact.sw: Mito kuzibwa na kutengeneza mabwawa ya asili yanayoweza kupasuka

en: Communities downstream of a blocked river: please evacuate immediately.
Do not cross or stand on the blockage.
District Committees: watch the blockage day and night and warn people downstream.
sw: Jamii zilizo chini ya mto ulioziba: tafadhali hameni mara moja.
Usivuke wala kusimama juu ya kizuizi.
Kamati za Wilaya: fuatilieni kizuizi usiku na mchana na watahadharisheni walio chini.

impact.en: Large numbers of households displaced
impact.sw: Idadi kubwa ya kaya kukosa makazi

en: Register at the shelter.
Help older persons, children, pregnant women and people with disabilities first.
District Committees: provide food, water, sanitation and protection in shelters.
sw: Jisajili kwenye makazi ya muda.
Wasaidie wazee, watoto, wajawazito na watu wenye ulemavu kwanza.
Kamati za Wilaya: toeni chakula, maji, huduma za usafi na ulinzi katika makazi ya muda.

impact.en: Water sources contaminated by mud and debris
impact.sw: Vyanzo vya maji kuchafuliwa na tope na kifusi

en: Drink only boiled or treated water.
Give ORS at the first sign of diarrhoea.
District Committees: supply safe water and water-treatment tablets.
sw: Kunywa maji yaliyochemshwa au kutibiwa tu.
Tumia ORS mara dalili za kuhara zinapoanza.
Kamati za Wilaya: sambazeni maji safi na vidonge vya kutibu maji.

impact.en: Widespread loss of farmland, livestock and food
impact.sw: Upotevu mkubwa wa mashamba, mifugo na chakula

en: Report losses to Village/Mtaa leaders.
District Committees: provide emergency food assistance.
Extension officers: assess crop and livestock losses.
sw: Toa taarifa ya hasara kwa viongozi wa Kijiji/Mtaa.
Kamati za Wilaya: toeni msaada wa dharura wa chakula.
Maafisa ugani: fanyeni tathmini ya hasara ya mazao na mifugo.

impact.en: Power and communication networks down
impact.sw: Kukatika kwa umeme na mitandao ya mawasiliano

en: Listen to official radio broadcasts.
Keep away from fallen power lines.
District Committees: use radio and messengers to reach cut-off villages.
sw: Sikiliza matangazo rasmi ya redio.
Kaa mbali na nyaya za umeme zilizoanguka.
Kamati za Wilaya: tumieni redio na wajumbe kufikia vijiji visivyofikika.

impact.en: Essential services disrupted for a long period
impact.sw: Kukatika kwa huduma muhimu kwa muda mrefu

en: Use stored water and food sparingly.
Rely only on official information.
District Committees: report needs to the Prime Minister's Office through the Regional Committee.
sw: Tumia akiba ya maji na chakula kwa uangalifu.
Tegemea taarifa rasmi tu.
Kamati za Wilaya: wasilisheni mahitaji Ofisi ya Waziri Mkuu kupitia Kamati ya Mkoa.

impact.en: Warning status
impact.sw: Hali ya tahadhari

en: Please stay with official sources: radio, TMA, Disaster Management Committees and local leaders.
Disaster Management Committees will announce when the danger has passed and when it is safe to return.
sw: Tafadhali tegemeeni taarifa rasmi: redio, TMA, Kamati za Usimamizi wa Maafa na viongozi wa eneo.
Kamati za Usimamizi wa Maafa zitatangaza hatari itakapokwisha na itakapokuwa salama kurudi.
